reason: Pre-submission review identified three remaining risks: the title overweights post hoc Sorensen equivalence, FrogID wording can sound like blinded external validation despite earlier positive FrogID multiplicity results, and the uniform-activation null may underrepresent strong species x stop persistence because historical cell probabilities are hierarchically shrunk.
authorized_changes: Add one persistence-preserving uniform-activation sensitivity family, frozen before endpoint readback.
Demote FrogID wording from independent/external validation to cross-dataset directional consistency while retaining the already frozen estimates.
Move practical Sorensen non-homogenization out of the title and make incidence allocation versus uniform activation the title-level result.
Compress robustness-method prose to Supporting Information if needed for JAE word count.
not_authorized: post-readback retuning of the persistence null
scientific_goal: Test whether the observed four-component allocation remains unusual when the null strongly preserves the pair-specific dry species x stop state.
